info.title: G-Commerce API
info.description:
The G-Commerce API is the backend of a demo online store: user accounts, a product catalog and purchases.
It is a Spring Boot application that issues and verifies its own RS256-signed JSON Web Tokens.

## Authentication

Most endpoints need an access token in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <access token>
```

1. Get an access token and a refresh token with `POST /api/auth/login`.
2. The access token expires after 60 minutes. Exchange the refresh token for a new pair with
   `POST /api/auth/refresh`; each refresh token works once and expires after 24 hours.
3. `POST /api/auth/logout` revokes the access token and the refresh token of the session.

Tokens are signed with rotating RSA keys, published at `/.well-known/jwks.json` for other services to verify them.

## Demo accounts

This deployment is a public demo, so anyone can sign in with these accounts and change the data:

| Email | Password | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `john@example.com` | `JohnDoe123!` | `USER`: can buy products |
| `admin@example.com` | `Admin123!` | `ADMIN`: can manage products and users |

## Errors

Errors use conventional HTTP status codes and share one JSON body, the `Error` schema:

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-20T09:30:00",
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "message": "Product not found",
  "path": "/api/products/42",
  "details": []
}
```

`message` explains the error, and `details` lists the specific problems, such as one entry per invalid field.

## Pagination

List endpoints take `page` (0-based), `size` (1 to 100), `sort` and `direction` (`ASC` or `DESC`)
query parameters, and return the items in `content` with the page metadata.

## Rate limits

Every client gets a bucket of requests that refills over time:

| Requests | Counted per | Burst | Refill per minute |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anonymous | IP address | 10 | 5 |
| Signed-in users | user | 30 | 20 |
| Administrators | user | 100 | 50 |
| Login attempts | IP address | 5 | 1 |

Successful responses carry an `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining` header. When the bucket is empty, the API answers
`429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header: the seconds to wait before trying again.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Sign in, refresh and revoke tokens, and check whether a token is still valid.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Register accounts and manage the signed-in user's profile. Administrators can also list the users and change their roles.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Browse the catalog, which is public, and manage the products as an administrator. Removing a product deactivates it, so it stays in the purchase history.

tags.name: Purchases
tags.description: Buy active products and read the purchase history. Users see their own purchases and administrators see all of them.

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Public signing keys and OpenID provider metadata, so other services can verify the tokens this API issues.

get.summary: Get the JSON Web Key Set
get.description: Returns the public RSA keys that verify the tokens of this API, in the JWKS format of RFC 7517: the active signing key first, then the keys retired by a rotation whose tokens haven't expired yet. Cache the keys, and fetch them again when a token has an unknown `kid`.
Returns the provider metadata of RFC 8414 and OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0: the issuer, the JWKS URI, the token endpoint and the supported grant types and signing algorithms.

post.description: Signs in with an email and a password, and returns the user with a new access token and refresh token. Login attempts are rate-limited per IP address.
Revokes the access token that authenticates the request and the refresh token in the body, so neither works again. A refresh token that is invalid, expired or issued to another user is ignored.

200.description: Logged out; the response has no body

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <refresh token>`, for a new access token and refresh token. Each refresh token works once: the used one is revoked, and sending it again gets a 401.

get.description: Checks whether the token in the `Authorization` header would be accepted as an access token: its signature, expiration, issuer, audience, type and revocation. An invalid token is not an error: the response reports `valid: false` and the reason.

value.message: Token is malformed or its signature is invalid

get.description: Returns a page of the catalog, optionally filtered by a text found in the name or the description. Anyone can list the active products; only administrators can list the inactive ones with `status=INACTIVE` or `status=ALL`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Which products to list: `ACTIVE`, or `INACTIVE` and `ALL` for administrators

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: Text to find in the name or the description, ignoring case

post.description: Adds a product to the catalog. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

put.description: Sets the name, description, price and status of a product. Setting `active` to `true` restores a deactivated product. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

delete.description: Removes a product from the public catalog by marking it inactive: it can't be bought anymore, but it stays in the purchase history. Restore it by updating it with `active` set to `true`. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

200.description: Product deactivated; the response has no body

get.description: Returns a page of the signed-in user's purchases, newest first by default. Administrators get the purchases of all the users.

post.description: Buys the given products for the signed-in user at their current prices. Requires the `USER` role: administrators can't make purchases. Inactive products can't be bought and are reported as not found.

get.description: Returns a page of all the users. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

post.description: Creates a user account; sign in with it at `POST /api/auth/login`. Anyone can register a `USER`, but registering an `ADMIN` requires an administrator's access token.

patch.description: Changes the name, email or password of the signed-in user; omitted fields keep their value. A password change needs `currentPassword`, `newPassword` and `confirmPassword`. The user's tokens keep working after an email change.
Gives a user the `USER` or `ADMIN` role. Requires the `ADMIN` role. The user's current access token keeps the old role until it expires or is refreshed.

200.description: Role changed; the response has no body

Error.description: The body of every error response

timestamp.description: When the error occurred, in server time without a time zone offset

details.description: Specific problems, such as one entry per invalid field; may be empty

Jwk.description: A public RSA key that verifies the signature of the tokens

kid.description: Key ID - unique identifier for this key

alg.description: Algorithm intended for use with this key

JwkSet.description: The public keys that verify the tokens of this API (RFC 7517)

LoginResponse.description: The signed-in user and a new pair of tokens

token.description: Access token: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshToken.description: Refresh token: exchange it for a new pair with `POST /api/auth/refresh`; it works once

refreshExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires

refreshToken.description: Refresh token of the session, revoked together with the access token

jwks_uri.description: URL of the authorization server's JWK Set document

grant_types_supported.description: Grant types supported by the authorization server

id_token_signing_alg_values_supported.description: JWS signing algorithms supported for ID Tokens

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items per page

totalElements.description: Total number of items across all pages

isLastPage.description: Whether this is the last page

isLastPage.description: Whether this is the last page

name.description: Product name, unique in the catalog

active.description: Whether the product is in the public catalog and can be bought

ProductRequest.description: The data of a product to create or update

name.description: Product name, unique in the catalog

price.description: Price in US dollars, greater than 0

active.description: Whether the product is in the public catalog and can be bought

Purchase.description: A purchase and the products bought

userName.description: Name of the user who made the purchase

PurchaseProductRequest.description: A product to buy and its quantity

products.description: Products to buy, with their quantities

unitPrice.description: Price paid per unit, in US dollars

subtotal.description: Unit price times quantity, in US dollars

RoleUpdate.description: Payload to update a user's role. Valid values: ADMIN, USER

role.description: New role to assign (ADMIN or USER)

TokenValidationResponse.description: Whether the token would be accepted as an access token

valid.description: Whether the token is a valid access token

message.description: `Token is valid`, or why the token is not valid

UpdateUserInfo.description: The profile fields to change; omitted fields keep their value. To change the password, send the current password, the new one and its confirmation.

newEmail.description: New email address; it must not belong to another user

currentPassword.description: Current password, required to change the password

newPassword.description: New password, at least 8 characters and different from the current one

email.description: Email address, used to sign in

role.description: Role: `USER` can buy products, `ADMIN` can manage products and users

UserRegistration.description: The data of a new user account

email.description: Email address, used to sign in; it must not be registered yet

role.description: Role of the new user. Only an administrator can register a user with the ADMIN role.

AdminRegistrationForbidden.description: Only an administrator can register a user with the `ADMIN` role.

value.message: Only administrators can create admin users

AuthenticationRequired.description: The request has no access token, or the token is invalid, expired or revoked.

BearerTokenRequired.description: The `Authorization` header is missing or doesn't contain a Bearer token. An invalid token is not an error: it is reported in a 200 response with `valid: false`.

details: The Authorization header with a Bearer token is missing

DuplicatedEmail.description: Another user already has this email.

value.message: A user with this email already exists

DuplicatedProduct.description: Another product, active or not, already has this name.

value.message: A product with this name already exists

InternalError.description: An unexpected error on the server.

InvalidCredentials.description: The email is not registered or the password is wrong. Both cases get the same answer, so it doesn't reveal which emails are registered.

InvalidInput.description: The request is invalid: a body field or a query parameter failed validation, or the body is not valid JSON. `details` lists each problem.

details: size: must be less than or equal to 100

InvalidProfileUpdate.description: The update is invalid: a field failed validation, or the password change was rejected.

details: newPassword: New password must be at least 8 characters long

value.message: The new password and its confirmation don't match

samePassword.summary: New password equals the current one

value.message: The new password must be different from the current password
details: The new password must be different from the current password

InvalidRefreshToken.description: The refresh token is missing, invalid, expired, already used or revoked by a logout.

value.message: Refresh token has already been used or revoked

details: The Authorization header with a Bearer token is missing

LoginRateLimitExceeded.description: Too many login attempts from this IP address: bursts of 5, refilled at 1 every 1 minute(s). Wait the seconds of the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request is accepted

ProductNotFound.description: No product has the given ID.

ProductStatusForbidden.description: Only administrators can list products that are not active (`status` other than `ACTIVE`).

value.message: Unauthenticated users can only access active products
Only administrators can access non-active products

PurchaseProductNotFound.description: A product of the purchase doesn't exist or is not active; the message names its ID.

RateLimitExceeded.description: The caller's rate limit is exhausted. Anonymous requests are limited per IP address (bursts of 10), and signed-in requests per user: 30 for users, 100 for administrators. Wait the seconds of the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request is accepted

UserNotFound.description: No user has the given ID.

value.message: No user exists with the provided ID

UserRoleRequired.description: The endpoint requires the `USER` role: administrators can't make purchases.

X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the caller's rate limit bucket

bearerAuth.description: An access token, the `token` field returned by `POST /api/auth/login` and `POST /api/auth/refresh`. It expires after 60 minutes.

refreshToken.description: A refresh token, the `refreshToken` field returned by `POST /api/auth/login` and `POST /api/auth/refresh`. Each one works once and expires after 24 hours.
